text:
maria: Deployed release v2.8.1 to canary (pool A) at 09:12 UTC. Starting lightweight smoke-suite: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. Asking deploy-bot to surface results here.

deploy-bot: started smoke-suite (canary-small). probes: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. ETA ~2m.

devin: Decision guideline in thread: hold or rollback if any canary p95 > 250ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for >1min. Otherwise continue monitoring.

sre-oncall: seeing embed-synth p95 climb in eu1: 280ms -> 320ms over last minute, 5xx ~0.9%. Raising a quick alert.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite results:
- kv-prefill: OK (p95 40ms)
- http-heartbeat: OK (no 5xx)
- embed-synth: ANOMALY: p95=318ms, 5xx=1.1%
Marking canary status: FAIL.

maria: Noted. Can we triage if this is a quant/profile change or a routing/regional capacity blip?

jess: Canary used model variant redwood-open/mtl-13b-quant-v2. That quant change was in the release. Might be related.

devin: My recommendation: rollback canary to previous stable (v2.7.4) and pin canary pools to that version for now. Execute rollback and auto re-run smoke.

/command:
/deploy rollback inference canary --to-version v2.7.4 --reason "embed-synth p95 spike in eu1"
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by devin at 09:14 UTC. Rolling back pool A -> v2.7.4. ETA ~40s. Will auto-run smoke-suite when done.

sre-oncall: Created INC-2026-451: embed-synth-5xx-eu1 to collect traces and tokenizer logs.

maria: After rollback: run post-rollback quick smoke-suite + extended embed-synth sweep for 10m in eu1 only, and run a KV warmup to validate prefix cache hit rate. Also capture the quant config used in the failed canary for reproducing locally.

jess: I'll pin canary to v2.7.4 and update the release notes: "Canary briefly rolled to v2.8.1; observed embed-synth regression in eu1; rolled back to v2.7.4. Investigation ongoing."

deploy-bot: Post-rollback smoke-suite results: kv-prefill OK, http-heartbeat OK, embed-synth p95=46ms 5xx=0.0% (eu1). Canary status: PASS. Canary pinned to v2.7.4 per jess.

maria: Good. Next steps: 1) reproduce embed-synth regression locally with v2.8.1 quant profile, 2) run extended embed-synth sweep against staging and canary with traffic shaping, 3) add a transient alert rule to catch p95 increases >100ms within 5m while we debug.

jess: I'll add note to changelog and ping product/pm. Leaving thread open for trace attachment and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
